    # print unique (note_id,title) first 12

        key=n['note_id']
        if key in seen: continue
        seen.add(key)
        out.append((n['note_id'],n['title'],n.get('pinned'),n.get('updated_at')))

    for item in out:
        print(' ',item)

note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='gl.moore@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0])['access_token'], note_id=1556)
content = note['content']
# parse lines like "<Title>" followed by " - director: <Director>"
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines()]
movies=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
for ln in lines:
    if not ln or ln.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if not ln.startswith('-'):
        # title line
        current_title = ln
        current_director = None
    elif ln.startswith('- director:'):
        current_director = ln.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        if current_title and current_director:
            movies.append((current_title,current_director))

# filter for Quentin Tarantino
filtered=[title for title,dirr in movies if dirr.lower()=='quentin tarantino']
# preserve order and remove duplicates
seen=set(); out=[]
for t in filtered:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); out.append(t)
print('Tarantino titles:', out)
